# HackifyPro — Full Unabridged Documentation for AI Agents

> HackifyPro is an Indian software development company founded by Nilesh Barela, specializing in high-speed website development, Android mobile applications, web applications, and custom business management software (Hospital HMS, Restaurant POS, Car Rental, Gym, and Driving School). Primary service market: Nashik, Maharashtra, India.

## 2. Software Development Services

### 2.1 Website Development
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/website-development
- **Overview**: Custom, fast, mobile-first business websites and high-converting landing pages built with React, Next.js, and semantic HTML5.
- **Key Features**: Sub-second load times, Core Web Vitals optimization (LCP < 2.5s, CLS < 0.1), structured Schema.org markup, and mobile-first responsiveness.

### 2.2 Android App Development
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/android-app-development
- **Overview**: Native Kotlin and cross-platform Android mobile applications engineered for high performance, smooth UI transitions, and Google Play Store compliance.

### 2.3 Web Application Development
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/web-application-development
- **Overview**: Scalable SaaS platforms, real-time client dashboards, and cloud web applications using modern full-stack architectures.

### 2.4 Custom Software Development
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/custom-software-development
- **Overview**: Bespoke internal management software replacing rigid spreadsheets and off-the-shelf software with tailored business logic.

### 2.5 Business Automation
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/business-automation
- **Overview**: WhatsApp Business API integrations, automated invoice dispatch, customer notification pipelines, and multi-platform data synchronization.

### 2.6 Software Maintenance & Support

## 3. Business Management Software Solutions

### 3.1 Hospital Management Software (HMS)
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/hospital-management-software
- **Overview**: Clinic and hospital administration system managing OPD appointments, IPD bed allocations, electronic health records (EHR), and pharmacy billing.

### 3.2 Car Rental Management Software
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/car-rental-software
- **Overview**: Vehicle fleet scheduling, Aadhaar and driving license verification, automated security deposit refunds, and digital rental agreements.

### 3.3 Restaurant Management & POS
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/restaurant-management-software
- **Overview**: Contactless dynamic QR menu ordering, Kitchen Display System (KDS), table seating layouts, and GST-compliant invoice generation.

### 3.4 Gym Management Software
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/gym-management-software
- **Overview**: Member subscription tracking, automatic WhatsApp fee renewal alerts, biometric access integration, and trainer schedule management.

### 3.5 Driving School Management Software
- **URL**: https://nileshbarela.site/driving-school-software
- **Overview**: Student registration, practical driving batch allocation, vehicle maintenance logs, and RTO exam preparation records.
